title: Capability graph
description: docs/generated/graph.json: the composed graph of the capability registry and every object of the `.ai/` index — one node per capability, object and projection, one edge per declared relation between them — as the Cockpit, the site and any reader outside this process see it. The generated shape of the node and edge types is published beside it as docs/generated/graph.schema.json; this file is the contract, the members a reader may rely on. Written by `majordomus generate graph`.

graph.description: The composed graph itself, as `majordomus graph composed` serves it.

source.description: What the graph was derived from, repository-relative or named; never a path on the machine that generated it.

node_kinds.description: Every kind a node may carry, with what it means; a node's `kind` is one of these keys.

edge_kinds.description: Every kind an edge may carry, with what it means; an edge's `kind` is one of these keys.

route.description: Where a reader opens this node, as a path of a served surface.

source.description: The file this node was read from, repository-relative.

truncated.description: Whether a limit cut the graph short; a published artifact carries the whole graph, so this is false.
